## TRA Timeline

#### Up-C IPO and TRA execution

- 2013-01-15: S-1/A first attaches the form-of TRA as Exhibit 10.5
- 2013-02-13: Up-C IPO closes; executed TRA dated February 13, 2013 filed as Exhibit 10.2 to the IPO 8-K with Michael W. Kosloske's Series B Member vehicles (HPI and HPI Sub) as beneficiaries

#### Madison Dearborn take-private and termination

- 2020-07-12: TRA Termination Agreement filed as Exhibit 10.2 to the merger announcement 8-K; substitutes a $40,014,495 cash Termination Payment for the Article 4.01 Early Termination Payment formula, conditional on merger close
- 2020-08-21: Madison Dearborn merger closes; TRA terminated immediately prior to the Merger Effective Time and the $40,014,495 Termination Payment becomes payable

## Explanation

Health Insurance Innovations (later renamed Benefytt Technologies) completed its Up-C IPO on February 13, 2013 and executed an 85% Tax Receivable Agreement with the founder Michael W. Kosloske's Series B Member vehicles, covering Section 754 basis step-ups from future Series B Membership Interest exchanges plus imputed-interest deductions. On July 12, 2020, concurrent with the Madison Dearborn merger agreement, the parties signed a TRA Termination Agreement (titled as a termination, not an amendment) that substituted a mutually agreed $40,014,495 cash payment for the contract's Section 4.01 ETP formula, conditional on merger close. The Madison Dearborn take-private closed August 21, 2020, the TRA terminated immediately prior to the Effective Time, and the payment became due. Benefytt deregistered after the close. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
